reviews.title: Quality
reviews.comment: Very nice fans, perform great, easy to install and exactly what I needed.

reviews.title: Just know before buying
reviews.comment: I would not buy these fans if you are going to use it for intake. The wire colors are all bright, and the sticker that goes on the fan is a metallic cover and will reflect any light.
reviews.author: Furmaan Tib
